$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-09-16 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report c7508d99. The sub2api image digest is the linux/amd64 child of the cosign-signed proof-v39 index (INDEX 0727d22a) built by publish-tee-images run 35062202921 from commit 7146fc1b5; the attestor image is deliberately left at its proof-v20 pin because deploy/attestor carries no change since that release. HOW THE IMAGE DIGEST WAS RESOLVED, stated plainly because the previous release got this wrong: the amd64 child was resolved with deploy/phala/pin-amd64.sh, which parses `imagetools inspect --raw` as JSON and matches on the platform field, and the result was re-checked against the compose pin with the same script's --verify mode. The index also carries an unknown/unknown attestation-manifest child (9a7bd3d0 for this index) which is NOT runnable; proof-v38 pinned that child by grepping the human-readable inspect output and took production down for about 15 minutes. VERIFICATION SCOPE: composeHash, the image digests and the build commit were each read back from a live source, and composeHash was cross-checked against two independent ones (RTMR3 event log and control plane). The cosign keyless signature was NOT verified locally for this release - cosign is not installed on the release machine - though the signing workflow run succeeded and anyone can verify certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market plus the embedded githubWorkflowSha against the sourceCommit below. This release adds two operator-facing supply-side features and touches no schema. (1) Supply incentive campaigns gain a per-campaign time origin: online-day counters are now bucketed per campaign under accounts.extra, each bucket starting from that campaign's start_at, so consecutive campaigns never inherit each other's days; start_at cannot be backdated because buckets only accrue forward and history cannot be rebuilt. Campaigns also gain new_users_only, restricting rewards to people who had no supply account at all before start_at, including disconnected ones so that disconnect-and-reconnect cannot launder an existing contributor into a new user. (2) An idle re-check for accounts already in the pool: accounts with no traffic for a configurable window get one upstream probe, and only repeated credential/quota failures take them out of the pool; rate-limited, overloaded and temporarily unschedulable accounts are never probed, because a maxed-out quota is evidence of successful supply rather than failure. Both ship OFF by default and do nothing until an operator enables them in admin. There is NO schema migration in this release - both features store their state in accounts.extra and in existing JSON settings keys. Operator note: the pre-existing supply_incentive_settings value had no start_at and is therefore dropped by the new fail-closed read path; the campaign was reconfigured after rollout with start_at 2026-09-16, new_users_only true, and enabled still false. Verified before rollout: full backend build and vet, the entire backend unit suite (58 packages) including new campaign-staging, new-user-scoping and idle-probe tests, the full repository integration suite against a real Postgres (including a mutation check confirming the include-disconnected-accounts rule is actually pinned by a test, and an upgrade-shaped test proving the new tick statement preserves every sibling key in a production-shaped accounts.extra), frontend type-check, and the full vitest suite (2070 passing). A full postgres backup was taken and verified immediately beforehand - downloaded from S3, gzip-tested, 110 COPY sections - kept as a rollback point even though no schema changed. Earlier in this line: proof-v38 (supply incentive rules engine and output balancing), proof-v37 (supply/demand gate, homepage stats), proof-v36 (OpenAI contributor sharing, migration 239), proof-v35 (upstream sync to 0.2.1 plus GPT-6 Astra), proof-v34 (fingerprint version floor), v33, v32, v31, v29, v28, v27, v26, v24..v15. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation, and the control plane confirms is_dev false after the rollout. This rollout completed in 169 seconds with no incident.
